controls.statement: Verify exported or printed representations do not misstate signature validity.

controls.primary_reason: Export and print renderers can be exercised with known valid, invalid, expired, revoked, and unverifiable signature fixtures.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every exported and printed representation displays the same signature-validity state as the authoritative verifier for approved status fixtures.

controls.statement: Prevent automated decisions from treating inability to present one credential format as evidence of ineligibility when alternatives are required.
